## Problem and result

Describe the user-visible change or the research conclusion.

<!-- Small fixes need only a concise problem/result and actual validation. Delete unused sections. Do not create an issue just to complete this template. -->

## Context (when relevant)

Link the owner's request, an existing issue, applicable PRD requirements or a milestone. A new issue is not required for a direct fix.

## Validation

State what was actually checked and the result. For documentation-only work, do not claim application tests.

## Limits and follow-up

List relevant unknowns, data compatibility effects, or remaining decisions. Research completion does not authorize implementation.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Requirements and documentation match the final scope.
- [ ] Source evidence and unknowns are accurately labeled.
- [ ] Course files, credentials, and personal records are excluded.
- [ ] Validation is appropriate to the change.
